sections.heading: Personalized Addiction Treatment in the Mountains of British Columbia

blocks.text: Foothills Centre for Change offers a personalized approach to addiction treatment in the serene mountains of British Columbia. The facility offers 30, 60, or 90 day programs with comprehensive medical detox, evidence-based therapies, and holistic services. For those who cannot commit to the typical 30 day program, Foothills Centre also offers a 14-day intensive residential package. The treatment experience at Foothills Centre is well-rounded, including individual and group therapy sessions, 12-Step facilitation, social activities, exercise, healthy meals, and time for relaxation and reflection.
blocks.html: Foothills Centre for Change offers a personalized approach to addiction treatment in the serene mountains of British Columbia. The facility offers 30, 60, or 90 day programs with comprehensive medical detox, evidence-based therapies, and holistic services. For those who cannot commit to the typical 30 day program, Foothills Centre also offers a 14-day intensive residential package. The treatment experience at Foothills Centre is well-rounded, including individual and group therapy sessions, 12-Step facilitation, social activities, exercise, healthy meals, and time for relaxation and reflection.

blocks.text: At Foothills Centre for Change, the focus is on treating the whole person, addressing the physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of addiction. Through therapeutic and educational groups, clients learn how to communicate honestly with themselves and others. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) addresses negative thoughts and actions related to addiction. Further, Foothills Centre treats the root of addiction by addressing co-occurring disorders such as personality disorders, grief, trauma, and anxiety. Foothills Centre also offers a wellness program, which includes yoga, meditation, amino acid therapy, and social connection.

centre.name: Foothills Centre for Change
centre.about_html:
Personalized Addiction Treatment in the Mountains of British Columbia

Foothills Centre for Change offers a personalized approach to addiction treatment in the serene mountains of British Columbia. The facility offers 30, 60, or 90 day programs with comprehensive medical detox, evidence-based therapies, and holistic services. For those who cannot commit to the typical 30 day program, Foothills Centre also offers a 14-day intensive residential package. The treatment experience at Foothills Centre is well-rounded, including individual and group therapy sessions, 12-Step facilitation, social activities, exercise, healthy meals, and time for relaxation and reflection.

Comprehensive And Personalized Treatment 

At Foothills Centre for Change, the focus is on treating the whole person, addressing the physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of addiction. Through therapeutic and educational groups, clients learn how to communicate honestly with themselves and others. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) addresses negative thoughts and actions related to addiction. Further, Foothills Centre treats the root of addiction by addressing co-occurring disorders such as personality disorders, grief, trauma, and anxiety. Foothills Centre also offers a wellness program, which includes yoga, meditation, amino acid therapy, and social connection.

Recover in a Serene Location 

Surrounded by the serene mountains of British Columbia, Foothills Centre for Change provides a peaceful setting for clients to recover. Private accommodations, weekly massages, and infra-red saunas are just a few of the amenities clients can enjoy during their stay. Family therapy sessions help reconnect clients with their support systems, and private aftercare sessions are included in all treatment packages. 

Cost and Insurance Coverage 

Foothills Centre for Change accepts most private insurance, and treatment packages are arranged by length of stay. Clients can choose from 30, 60, or 90 day programs, as well as a 14-day intensive residential package. Private aftercare sessions are provided for all clients to ensure ongoing support after treatment. 

Foothills Centre for Change- Center Overview

Foothills Centre for Change is a leading rehab center dedicated to offering individuals a holistic approach to wellness. The center focuses on providing compassionate care, encouragement, and comprehensive support to help patients get their lives back on track. At Foothills, patients can repair relationships, regain confidence, and rediscover their true selves through a range of programs and therapies tailored to meet their unique needs. With the right guidance and support, change is possible, and healing can begin today at Foothills.

The center provides a peaceful and comfortable environment where patients can receive world-class education, therapy, and wellness services. The team at Foothills understands that patients need a balance of self-care, therapy, and education to ensure a complete recovery. Therefore, patients are treated in a home-like setting designed to foster a calm and supportive atmosphere. Whether it’s addiction or mental health issues, Foothills Center for Change has the resources and expertise to help patients achieve positive outcomes and regain control of their lives.

raw_html:
Personalized Addiction Treatment in the Mountains of British Columbia

Foothills Centre for Change offers a personalized approach to addiction treatment in the serene mountains of British Columbia. The facility offers 30, 60, or 90 day programs with comprehensive medical detox, evidence-based therapies, and holistic services. For those who cannot commit to the typical 30 day program, Foothills Centre also offers a 14-day intensive residential package. The treatment experience at Foothills Centre is well-rounded, including individual and group therapy sessions, 12-Step facilitation, social activities, exercise, healthy meals, and time for relaxation and reflection.

Comprehensive And Personalized Treatment 

At Foothills Centre for Change, the focus is on treating the whole person, addressing the physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of addiction. Through therapeutic and educational groups, clients learn how to communicate honestly with themselves and others. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) addresses negative thoughts and actions related to addiction. Further, Foothills Centre treats the root of addiction by addressing co-occurring disorders such as personality disorders, grief, trauma, and anxiety. Foothills Centre also offers a wellness program, which includes yoga, meditation, amino acid therapy, and social connection.

Recover in a Serene Location 

Surrounded by the serene mountains of British Columbia, Foothills Centre for Change provides a peaceful setting for clients to recover. Private accommodations, weekly massages, and infra-red saunas are just a few of the amenities clients can enjoy during their stay. Family therapy sessions help reconnect clients with their support systems, and private aftercare sessions are included in all treatment packages. 

Cost and Insurance Coverage 

Foothills Centre for Change accepts most private insurance, and treatment packages are arranged by length of stay. Clients can choose from 30, 60, or 90 day programs, as well as a 14-day intensive residential package. Private aftercare sessions are provided for all clients to ensure ongoing support after treatment. 

Foothills Centre for Change- Center Overview

Foothills Centre for Change is a leading rehab center dedicated to offering individuals a holistic approach to wellness. The center focuses on providing compassionate care, encouragement, and comprehensive support to help patients get their lives back on track. At Foothills, patients can repair relationships, regain confidence, and rediscover their true selves through a range of programs and therapies tailored to meet their unique needs. With the right guidance and support, change is possible, and healing can begin today at Foothills.

The center provides a peaceful and comfortable environment where patients can receive world-class education, therapy, and wellness services. The team at Foothills understands that patients need a balance of self-care, therapy, and education to ensure a complete recovery. Therefore, patients are treated in a home-like setting designed to foster a calm and supportive atmosphere. Whether it’s addiction or mental health issues, Foothills Center for Change has the resources and expertise to help patients achieve positive outcomes and regain control of their lives.
